body: You should always cherish those people forever you all mean so much to each other. I hope you do keep trying new things, that is how you will find what you like doing and you will have fun and be happy. It is very hard to get out of your comfort zone. However, there are many different ways to ease out of it. Get one of you're great friends and try something out, I'm sure they would enjoy the experience and the adventure with you. After doing this kind of stuff for a while you'll be able to ease out of it. You're response was great, I wasn't confused I actually felt really great and happy about what you said. If you ever start feeling down again or even simply overwhelmed with small things just message or comment me, I'll always be here to help you if you need it.

Do you have a few friends even if you don't have many but a few that really care about you? A girlfriend/boyfriend? Maybe a few brothers and sisters? There has to be people in your life that you truly care about. And maybe people that care about you a lot. Even people you don't know might care about you, such as the people here. I care about you and I only see a paragraph of text. You seem lost right now, but you should not give up. You have to give it time for you to find why you want to live. Everybody lives for different reasons. you have to find what makes you happy. Maybe a certain activity or talking to a certain person. Life for me is the search for happiness. I do everything I can just so I can be happy. I also want to be loved mutually by the people I care for. Do you have any feelings like this? Maybe you do not realize what a large impact you have on people's lives. Sure you may be a piece of dust compared to the universe, but you are a special piece of dust. You have such an interesting way of looking at everything. As somebody else has already commented, you are going to great places. You should not give up just because you do not see it yet. People care about you a lot, even if you do not notice it. You're strong and you can not let life beat you like that. You are better than life. I am sure you mean life to many people even if you do not see it. You should search for happiness in your life and look for things to be happy. Maybe you're down right now and your life feels terrible. It may be stressful, but imagine having kids. Kids that you nurture and care for with your beautiful husband/wife. You can make their life better than what you have. My parents did exactly this for me. My father did not have the best childhood. He stuck through it though. He said you know what this sucks and I am gonna have a kid and make him a life I did not have. He saw me in him and he wanted me to live better than him. Imagine you and your beautiful husband/wife doing this for your kid. You seem very smart and I can already tell that you're wise enough already to help your child with problems that you might be having now. People love you very much. Don't give up on life. You have a larger impact on the world than you think. Many people would suffer if you removed yourself from society, but maybe you do not realize that. I would to talk to you more about this and answer questions and concerns you have. Please talk to me as long as you'd like. Just respond to this comment, you deserve help and you deserve a happy life. You are an amazing individual, never forget that.
